tests: Choosing a purchasing option for a nightly interruptible job while minimizing cost.
expected: Spot Instances (up to ~90% savings). Triggers: "can be interrupted and restarted", "3-hour nightly batch", "minimize cost".
why_not: Reserved Instances are a long commitment for 24/7; On-Demand is much more expensive than Spot; Dedicated Hosts are for licensing/isolation, not savings.
